summary: Create a 3-page interactive Happy Birthday website with a playful, warm, slightly teasing tone; soft pink/peach/golden gradients; smooth transitions; animations (balloons, sparkles, petals, confetti on moments); and mobile-responsive navigation between pages.
architectural_notes: Use a simple 3-section/page structure (multi-section single-page or 3 HTML pages) with Next/Previous navigation; ensure Previous is visible on pages 2 and 3 only.
Trigger confetti only on specified celebration moments (Page 1 reveal click; Page 3 after 3s) to match performance and tone.
All animations (balloons, sparkles, petals) should be subtle and mobile-friendly; respect prefers-reduced-motion where possible.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Cute panda holding a bouquet of flowers, clean vector-like style, pastel colors, transparent background (panda-flowers.dim_768x768.png)
- Small sparkle particle sprite set, subtle golden-white sparkles on transparent background (sparkles-sprites.dim_512x512.png)
- Soft flower petal sprite set, light pink/peach petals on transparent background (petals-sprites.dim_512x512.png)
- Single balloon illustration (round balloon with string), pastel pink/peach on transparent background (balloon-single.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Implement a 3-page, mobile-responsive birthday website with smooth fade/slide transitions between pages and clear navigation controls: Page 1 shows only a “Next Page” button when unlocked; Pages 2 and 3 must always include a visible “Previous Page” button and also include a “Next Page” button where specified.

Apply the global visual design consistently across all pages: soft pink/peach/warm-golden gradients, elegant rounded modern typography, deep black readable text, subtle sparkles, floating balloons (where specified), and confetti used only during celebration moments.

Build Page 1 (“GRAND BIRTHDAY ENTRY”) with: a soft glowing pink-peach gradient background; floating balloons that slowly move upward; centered text that starts as “Hey You 🌸
Guess what day it is?” and automatically fades after 2 seconds into “It’s not just a date.
It’s a national-level event.”; a large button labeled “Reveal the Birthday Girl 👀”. On click: trigger a confetti burst and a brief screen-glow animation, then reveal the message “Happy Birthday ✨
To someone who makes ordinary days better
just by existing.” and show a “Next Page” button.

Add optional subtle background instrumental birthday music on Page 1 with safe defaults: do not autoplay audio by default; provide a small, unobtrusive play/pause control so users can opt-in to audio.

Build Page 2 (“OFFICIAL BIRTHDAY REPORT”) with a cute animated newspaper/celebration-board aesthetic and the exact provided text content, including the “Charges” bullet list and “Verdict / Punishment” lines. Include a button labeled “Accept Birthday Flowers 🌷” that, when clicked, reveals a cute animated panda or kitten holding flowers and shows the message “Today, you don’t chase goals.\nYou receive flowers.” Include “Previous Page” and “Next Page” buttons.

Build Page 3 (“SOFT WISH PAGE”) with a warm golden-pink glow theme and a soft falling flower-petals animation. Display the provided multi-paragraph wish text and bullet list. After 3 seconds on the page, trigger a gentle confetti fall (time-based, not user-triggered). Show the final line “Happy Birthday.\nYou’re appreciated more than you realize.” and end with a softly glowing “The End” text. Include a visible “Previous Page” button.

Add generated static image assets for the “panda or kitten holding flowers” reveal (Page 2) and any small sparkle/petal sprites used for animations; load them from frontend static assets (not from the backend).
